question: If int *p points to the first element of an int array, what does p + 1 refer to?
options: The address of the next int in the array (p's address plus sizeof(int) bytes)
The address of p plus exactly 1 byte
A compile-time error, since pointers cannot be added to
explanation: Pointer arithmetic is scaled by the pointed-to type's size, so p + 1 advances by sizeof(int) bytes, pointing to the next int element in the array.
